incident-bot: PAGER | Sev2 - multi-GPU collective stalls detected on cluster-gpu-prod-6. Affected service: serving-runtime. Root TS: 1918765432
sylvia.kim: paging oncall — seeing repeated NCCL communicator timeouts on TP training jobs. A few containers stuck in allreduce for >30s. Job ids: tp-job-237, tp-job-239. Metrics spike: allreduce latency -> inf, GPU util pinned, backlog increasing. Logs:
```
[warn] NCCL WARN Call to ncclGroupEnd timed out after 30000 ms
[error] ncclCommInitRank failed: unhandled cuda error 77
[info] TensorParallelGroup(2): waiting at allreduce
```
raj.oncall: I'm on it. What does customer impact look like? Any external traffic flowing through serving? :eyes:
kevin.ml: TP training only, but serving-runtime uses same node pool for dedup/prep path. We see increased 503s on two endpoints proxied through gpuhost-42. Customers: internal smoke + one external (acme-corp) reported slow inference.
maria.ops: I'm isolating gpuhost-42 from the autoscaler to prevent new pods scheduling: `kubectl cordon gpuhost-42 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data gpuhost-42`
raj.oncall: Good. Also set NCCL to fallback to tcp for those pods: `kubectl set env pod/$(pod) NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` — this will avoid RDMA/IB which is flapping.
sylvia.kim: We're pushing a config rollout to route new inference traffic to dedicated single-gpu variant (fallback-1g) for affected models. This should mitigate external customer impact while we debug TP layer.
kevin.ml: On gpuhost-42 I grabbed a core dump from the worker. Stack shows cuda driver complaining about 'illegal memory access' inside ncclAllReduce. Attaching snippet:
```
#0  ncclRingAllReduce(...) at nccl_coll.c:124
#1  0x7fbc4a... cudaMemcpyAsync -> cudaErrorIllegalAddress
```
maria.ops: Driver is NVIDIA 525.85; kernel 6.1. We haven't upgraded recently. I'll try restarting the container runtime on gpuhost-42 after drain and monitor.
raj.oncall: Rolling restart of the worker fleet in that AZ, one at a time, to clear possible stale RDMA state. Maria — coordinate with infra to restart containerd on hosts with these symptoms.
maria.ops: Restarted containerd on gpuhost-42; restarted affected pods. Observing reduced allreduce stalls. 503 rate back to baseline for acme-corp. :thumbsup:
sylvia.kim: Next steps: open an incident ticket, collect per-host NCCL logs, and run a controlled repro with NCCL_IB_DISABLE toggles to confirm if IB is the root cause. Also consider bumping NCCL to latest stable in the next runtime image.
raj.oncall: And add a short-term routing rule: prefer single-GPU variants for 'low-latency' serving routes while we validate. If we see recurrence, escalate to eng-runtime and vendor (NVIDIA) with dumps.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE | state=mitigated, severity=2, owner=raj.oncall, notes=isolated host, containerd restart, tcp fallback enabled for affected pods. Followups: eng-runtime to reproduce, SRE to collect host-level RDMA counters. Last TS: 1918765740
